goal_summary: Coordinate the research, architectural validation, business analysis, and implementation planning phases for the E-commerce Admin Dashboard UI and backend API.

phases.name: Business Requirements & Gap Analysis
exit_criteria: Create full flow BA review brief detailing all Gaps across e-commerce modules.
Populate updated business rules and functional requirements.

phases.name: UI/UX Dashboard Research & Flow Spec
exit_criteria: Produce ux-flow-spec.json and component-spec.json files for Admin Dashboard.

phases.name: Architecture Review & ADR Publish
exit_criteria: Review UX brief, accept/reject design options, publish adr-spec.json containing technical rules.

phases.name: Technical Delivery Planning
exit_criteria: Create technical-delivery-plan.json splitting implementation into slices with quality gates.

residual_risks: D1 Query aggregation performance needs real data profiling once implemented.
Stripe refund status synchronizations require end-to-end sandbox webhook validation.
